what: a fire elemental: a living blaze, real fire and nothing else. It is one tall flame burning in mid-air, the flame of a great bonfire with nothing beneath it: wide in the middle, drawn out to a tall pointed tip at the top and to one thin curling wisp at the bottom, made of many separate licking tongues of flame with ragged edges, so that the backdrop shows between the tongues. Two thirds of the way up, set directly in the fire, are two bright yellow-white slanted eyes and a jagged yellow-white mouth. One long tongue of flame lashes out from each side of the blaze, tapering to a point.
colours: deep orange-red flame at the edges and tips, bright orange flame in the middle, yellow-white eyes and mouth. It is the colour of a wood fire all through.
wears: It is fire and wears nothing.
holds: It is a flame and holds nothing.
pose: The whole flame leans and bends to the left as if blown, its tip curling over, the tongue of flame on its left side lashing far out ahead and the one on its right side whipped up high.
must_show: real fire in every part: licking tongues of flame, no solid body
a tall flame shape, pointed at the top, a thin wisp at the bottom
two eyes and a mouth set directly in the fire
one lashing tongue of flame on each side
plain orange-red fire: the lowest fire tier

what: a greater fire elemental: a great living blaze, real fire and nothing else, broader and fiercer than an ordinary fire elemental. It is one tall, wide flame burning in mid-air, the flame of a furnace with nothing beneath it, made of many thick licking tongues of flame with ragged edges, narrowing at the bottom to one curling wisp. At the top the fire splits into a crown of five tall pointed tongues of flame standing straight up side by side. In the very middle of the blaze burns one big round white-hot core, white as a forge at full blast, shading outward to yellow and then orange. Above the core, set directly in the fire, are two white-hot slanted eyes and a jagged white-hot mouth. One thick tongue of flame reaches out from each side of the blaze, and each ends in three hooked claws of flame.
colours: bright orange and golden-yellow flame all through, one round white-hot core in the middle, white eyes and mouth, dark orange-red only at the outermost tips.
wears: It is fire and wears nothing; its crown is five tongues of its own flame.
holds: It is a flame and holds nothing.
pose: The whole blaze leans to the left, its two clawed tongues of flame spread wide and reaching forward to seize, the white core blazing, its crown of flame streaming back.
must_show: real fire in every part: licking tongues of flame, no solid body
a big round white-hot core in the middle
a crown of tall flame points at the top
a clawed tongue of flame on each side
wider and brighter than the plain fire elemental

what: a primordial fire elemental: the oldest fire in the world, a living blaze burning white-hot, real fire and nothing else. It is one great broad flame burning in mid-air with nothing beneath it, made of many thick licking tongues of white and pale gold flame with ragged edges, narrowing to one curling wisp at the bottom, with orange only at the very tips. At its top the fire gathers into one round white-hot ball of fire, and straight out of that ball, all the way round it and joined to it, stand long straight golden spikes of flame. Set directly in the white ball are two narrow slanted burning-orange eye slits and nothing else. From each side of the blaze one long thick whip of golden flame curls outward and upward in a great arc.
colours: white-hot and pale gold flame all through; a white ball of fire at the top with golden-yellow spikes of flame all round it; two golden flame whips; orange only at the outermost tips; two burning-orange eye slits.
wears: It is fire and wears nothing.
holds: It is a flame and holds nothing.
pose: The whole blaze surges and leans to the left, the two whips of flame flung wide and high in arcs on either side, the spiked ball of fire thrust forward.
must_show: real fire in every part: licking tongues of flame, no solid body
white and gold all through, far brighter than the orange fire elementals
a round ball of fire at the top with straight spikes of flame all round it
a long arcing whip of flame on each side
two eye slits and no other face

what: a magma elemental: a small, squat walking heap of molten rock. It is glowing liquid stone in every part, thick and soft and slowly pouring: one low, wide, slumped mound, much wider at the bottom than the top, carried on two short stumpy pillars of the same molten rock, with one short thick stubby arm of molten rock on each side ending in a heavy round fist. Its whole surface glows bright orange and yellow, smooth and wet, with a few wide irregular rafts of dark cooling crust drifting on it and bright glowing streams running down between them. Thick drips hang from the mound and from the two fists. High on the front of the mound, set directly in the molten rock, are two round white-hot eye-holes and one wide sagging glowing mouth-hole, and nothing else.
colours: glowing bright orange and yellow molten rock in every part; a few irregular rafts of dark brown-black cooling crust; white-yellow eye-holes and mouth-hole.
wears: It is molten rock and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its two dripping fists are empty.
pose: It trudges to the left on its two stumpy pillars, leaning forward, one dripping fist swung up high to strike and the other hanging low.
must_show: glowing molten rock in every part
a low squat slumped mound on two stumpy legs
thick hanging drips
two white-hot eye-holes and a mouth-hole, no other face
mostly glowing: only a few rafts of dark crust
two short thick arms with empty fists
must_not_show: thick black rock crust over everything

what: a lava elemental: a massive, broad, heavy hulk walking on two thick legs, armoured from head to foot in a thick crust of black volcanic rock. Every part of it, the head, chest, arms, fists and legs alike, is covered in big rough plates of black rock, and between the plates run wide glowing orange cracks where the molten rock inside shows through. Great jagged slabs of black rock stand on its shoulders and a crown of black rock spikes stands on its head. Set directly in the black rock of the head are two glowing orange eyes and a glowing orange furnace mouth. Its fists are two huge black boulders with glowing cracks across the knuckles.
colours: black and dark charcoal rock crust on every part, the head included; bright orange and yellow glowing cracks between the plates; glowing orange eyes and mouth.
wears: It wears nothing; its armour is its own crust of black rock.
holds: It holds nothing; both boulder fists are empty.
pose: It strides forward to the left on two thick legs, body twisted, one boulder fist raised high to slam down and the other swung back.
must_show: a thick black rock crust on every part, the head included
glowing orange cracks between the plates
jagged shoulder slabs and a crown of rock spikes
huge boulder fists, empty
far bigger, harder and more armoured than the soft magma elemental
must_not_show: body that is mostly glowing with no crust
plain grey stone with no glow

what: an ice elemental: a small, plain walking figure built of rough broken chunks of ice. It is ice in every part, clear and hard: about eight separate jagged lumps of ice stacked together with gaps between them. The biggest lump is the trunk; on top of it sits one smaller rough wedge of ice, a plain blank lump with no face on it at all; on each side is an arm made of two jagged ice lumps, one after the other, frozen together, ending in a bunch of three long sharp icicles; underneath are two short blunt lumps of ice that it walks on. The ice is see-through pale blue, cracked inside, with white frost on its upper faces. Every lump is a rough natural shard with slanting broken faces, none of them square.
colours: pale ice-blue and clear cyan ice on every part; white frost.
wears: It is ice and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its two bunches of icicles are empty.
pose: It lunges forward to the left on its two short ice lumps, leaning far over, one bunch of icicles thrust out ahead to touch and the other drawn back.
must_show: ice in every part: rough see-through shards
a plain blank wedge of ice on top, with no face
long icicles where hands would be, empty
small and plain: no crown, no beard of icicles, no core
must_not_show: patch of snow or ice under it
cloud of mist around the body

what: a primordial ice elemental: an ancient, towering figure of glacier ice, the first cold in the world. It is ice in every part, hard and faceted, with nothing soft anywhere, built of huge angular blocks of old glacier ice: massive block shoulders, a broad chest block, heavy arms of ice ending in great claws of ice, and two thick legs that are pillars of ice. Its ice is deep and dark, the dark blue of the heart of a glacier, crusted on top with thick white rime. A tall crown of long sharp ice spires rises from its head and along its shoulders, a long beard of icicles hangs from its jaw, and in the middle of its chest shines one white star-shaped core of frost. Set directly in the ice of the head are two glowing white eyes.
colours: deep glacier-blue and dark blue ice on every part, the head included; thick white rime; pale cyan spire tips and icicles; one white core in the chest; white eyes.
wears: It is ice and wears nothing; its crown is spires of its own ice.
holds: It holds nothing; both ice claws are empty.
pose: It strides forward to the left on two pillar legs, body twisted, one great ice claw raised high overhead and the other spread low.
must_show: ice in every part, the head included: faceted blocks
deep dark glacier-blue ice with white rime, darker than the plain ice elemental
a tall crown of ice spires on head and shoulders
a beard of icicles
a white core in the chest
empty ice claws
must_not_show: small plain body of pale ice
cloud of mist around the body
patch of snow or ice under it

what: an earth elemental: a heap of boulders that has stood up. It is built of about ten separate big boulders of pale tan limestone, stacked and balanced, with dark gaps and dark brown packed earth between them. Every stone is real weathered rock: rough, pitted, cracked and lumpy, with broken edges, never smooth. One very large boulder is the trunk. On top of it sits one smaller plain blank boulder with no face on it at all. On each side is an arm made of three boulders, one after the other, touching, the last and biggest of them one rough stone fist. Underneath are two short stacks of two flat boulders each, which it walks on.
colours: pale tan and sandy-buff limestone boulders in every part; dark brown earth and dark gaps between the boulders.
wears: It is stone and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; both stone fists are empty.
pose: It lumbers forward to the left on its two short stacks of stone, leaning, one round stone fist drawn back high to punch and the other swung forward.
must_show: separate rough boulders in every part, with dark gaps between them
pale tan limestone and brown earth
a plain blank boulder on top, with no face
two stone fists, empty
plain: no crystals, no ore veins, no eyes
must_not_show: eyes or gems on the trunk

what: a greater earth elemental: a massive heap of deep rock that has stood up, heavier and harder than an ordinary earth elemental. It is built of about ten separate huge jagged slabs and broken boulders of dark grey granite, stacked with black gaps between them. Every stone is real quarried rock: rough, split and irregular, with slanting broken faces, none of them square. The trunk is one great rough upright slab. On top of it, sunk low between two big jagged shoulder rocks, is one low rough lump of rock with nothing on it except two small glowing yellow eyes set directly in the stone. On each side is an arm made of two jagged rocks, one after the other, touching, ending in one enormous round boulder, a fist as big as the slab itself. Underneath are two thick stacks of dark rock that it walks on. Clusters of tall, hard, six-sided, pointed pale quartz crystals grow from the two shoulder rocks and from its back, and thick bright veins of yellow gold ore run across the dark rock.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and slate-grey granite on every part; pale yellow-white quartz crystals; thick bright yellow-gold veins; two small yellow eyes.
wears: It is stone and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; both boulder fists are empty.
pose: It stands on two thick rock legs leaning forward to the left with both enormous boulder fists raised together high above its head, about to slam them down.
must_show: separate angular blocks of dark grey granite in every part, with gaps between them
a great flat slab for a trunk
two enormous boulder fists, empty
quartz crystals growing from the top
gold veins: richer and heavier than the plain tan earth elemental
must_not_show: separate boulder held in the hands

what: a living thunderstorm: one dark storm cloud with eyes, floating alone in empty air. It is storm cloud in every part and nothing else. Its top is one heavy mass of dark cloud piled high in big rounded billows, broad and wide, with one great rolling billow thrust out on each side. From the middle of its underside one thick twisting column of the same dark cloud hangs straight down, narrowing all the way to a blunt point at the bottom: this column is its only lower part. On the front of the cloud near the top, set directly in it side by side, are two large glowing yellow-white eyes with no pupils, slanted and fierce, and nothing else. Thick, bold forks of yellow-white lightning run across the front of the cloud and down the column, staying inside its outline, and one thick jagged bolt jumps from one side billow to the other.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and slate-grey cloud over the whole body, paler grey on the tops of the billows; bright yellow-white lightning; yellow-white eyes.
wears: It is cloud and wears nothing.
holds: It is a cloud and holds nothing. The cloud is the only thing in the picture.
pose: The whole storm leans to the left in the air in the middle of the picture, one side billow thrust far forward and the other piled up high, its dark column twisting beneath it, the lightning bolt arcing between the billows.
must_show: dark storm cloud in every part: rounded billows on top, no solid body
one thick twisting column of dark cloud hanging down to a point
thick yellow-white lightning on the cloud
two large glowing eyes set in the cloud
a rolling billow thrust out on each side

what: an air elemental: a whirlwind with a will. It is wind in every part and nothing else: one tall spinning funnel of pale grey-white wind, wide at the top and tapering down to a thin twisting point at the bottom, drawn as bold curved bands of wind winding round and round it. Caught in the bands and whirling with them are pieces of grit: small brown stones, dry brown leaves and sharp wooden splinters. On the front of the funnel near the top, set directly in the wind side by side, are two large round glowing yellow eyes, bright as lamps, and nothing else. From each side of the upper funnel one smaller twisting ribbon of wind curls outward and ends in a sharp hook.
colours: pale grey and white bands of wind with soft tan dust over the whole figure; dark brown splinters, leaves and stones; two large bright yellow eyes.
wears: It is wind and wears nothing.
holds: It is wind and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, level with it, the whole funnel leans to the left in the air, spinning, the ribbon of wind on its left side slashing forward and the other curled back, its thin point twisting beneath it.
must_show: a spinning funnel of pale wind bands, wide at the top
tapering to a thin point at the bottom
grit, leaves and splinters whirling in it
two large glowing yellow eyes set directly in the wind
a curling ribbon of wind on each side
must_not_show: cloud of dust on the ground under it
spikes or rocks standing on top
open bowl top seen from above

what: a water elemental: a standing wave with something like a face. It is sea water in every part and nothing else, clear and glassy with ripples running through it: one tall thick wave of water rising straight up and curling forward at the top into a heavy breaking crest of white foam. In the dark hollow under the curl of the crest, set directly in the water, are two narrow slanted glowing white slits for eyes, fierce, with no pupils, and nothing else. From each side of the wave one smaller wave swings outward and ends in a curled splash of white foam. Its lower end is a rounded swirl of water hanging in the air.
colours: deep sea-blue and blue-green water over the whole figure, paler see-through blue at the edges; white foam on the crest and the two side splashes; two narrow glowing white eye slits.
wears: It is water and wears nothing.
holds: It is water and holds nothing.
pose: The whole wave rears up leaning to the left with its foaming crest curling over, about to crash down, the side wave on its left flung high and the other reaching forward.
must_show: water in every part: one tall wave, no solid body
a curling crest of white foam at the top
two narrow glowing eye slits set in the water under the crest, and no other face
a smaller wave swinging out on each side
a rounded swirl below

what: a void elemental: a hole cut in the air. It is one tall, upright, ragged patch of pure flat black nothingness, taller than it is wide, a long oval with a sharp jagged torn outline, the shape of a rip in a curtain. Inside it is flat pure black with no shading, and in the black near the top, side by side, are two small bright white dots of light, its eyes, plain to see. All round its edge runs a thin bright rim of pale silver-white light with short jagged teeth. Exactly two long thin jagged spikes of the same flat pure black stretch outward from it, one from the left side and one from the right side, each tapering to a point and rimmed with the same thin silver-white light.
colours: pure flat black inside, in every part; a thin bright silver-white rim of light round every edge; pale silver-white streaks; two white eye points.
wears: It is emptiness and wears nothing.
holds: It is a hole and holds nothing.
pose: It leans to the left in the air, the black spike on its left side stretched far forward to touch and the other slanting up, its jagged lower end hanging clear of everything.
must_show: a flat pure black shape with no shading: a hole, not a body
a thin bright silver-white rim round its jagged edge
two small white eye points
one long black spike reaching out on each side, two in all

what: an entropy elemental: a patch of grey static hanging in the air. It is one tall, upright, ragged patch of static, taller than it is wide, a long oval with a jagged torn outline, flat like a rip in a curtain. Inside it is nothing but dense coarse speckle, the snow on a dead television screen: sharp little squares of ash-grey, white and black packed together, with no shading. In the static near the top, side by side, are two small bright white dots of light, its eyes, plain to see. Its edge is eaten into square notches all the way round, and its lower end is breaking up into big square flakes that fall away from it, still touching it. Broad rust-brown stains spread inward from its edges. Exactly two long thin jagged spikes of the same grey static stretch outward from it, one from the left side and one from the right side, each crumbling into square flakes at its tip.
colours: ash-grey, white and black speckle in every part; rust-brown stains at the edges; two small white eye dots. Plain neutral grey, never tinted.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It is a patch of static and holds nothing.
pose: It leans to the left in the air, the spike of static on its left side stretched far forward to touch and the other slanting up, its lower end breaking into square flakes.
must_show: a flat ragged patch of coarse grey speckled static: the same shape as the void elemental, grey speckle where that one is black
edges eaten into square notches, crumbling into square flakes below
rust-brown stains
two small white eye dots
one long crumbling spike on each side

what: an ettin: a huge, crude, pot-bellied two-headed giant. He has one thick body with one pair of broad shoulders, exactly two arms and exactly two legs, and on the shoulders two thick necks side by side, each with its own ugly bald head: heavy brows, big lumpy noses and jutting lower jaws with two blunt tusks. The two heads lean away from each other, the left one shouting with its mouth wide open, the right one scowling with its mouth shut. Each head is small for the big body.
colours: dirty ochre-tan skin with grey warts on both heads and the whole body, a dark brown hide loincloth, two plain pale brown wooden clubs.
wears: He wears only a ragged patched hide loincloth tied with rope, and is barefoot. No armour, no helmets, nothing on either head.
holds: He holds exactly one plain rough wooden club in each hand: the club in his right hand is raised high, the club in his left hand is held low out to the side. Two clubs in all.
pose: He stomps forward to the left on two legs, weight on the front foot, body twisted, right club raised high to strike and left club swung out low.
must_show: two heads side by side on one body
exactly two arms and two legs
one plain wooden club in each hand
a hide loincloth only: both heads bare
crude and plain: no armour, no iron

what: an ettin warchief: a giant with two heads. Two separate heads sit side by side on his one pair of broad shoulders, each on its own thick neck, both heads the same size and both plainly seen from the front, with a gap between them. He is huge, scarred and heavy-shouldered, the old chief of a ruined clan, with one thick body, exactly two arms and exactly two legs. Each head has heavy brows, a big lumpy nose, a jutting lower jaw with two blunt tusks and a braided dark beard. The head on the right of the picture bellows an order with its mouth wide open; the head on the left of the picture glares the other way with its mouth shut. Each head is small for the big body.
colours: dirty ochre-tan scarred skin on both heads and the whole body, dark grey iron helmets, weapon heads and shoulder plate, a dark brown fur mantle, a brown hide war-kilt, bone-white skulls on the belt.
wears: He wears a heavy dark brown fur mantle over both shoulders, one big spiked iron plate strapped on his left shoulder, a wide iron-studded belt hung with three small skulls, a hide war-kilt and iron-bound boots. Each of his two heads wears its own crude dented iron helmet: one helmet has two short horns, the other helmet has one tall spike and no horns.
holds: He holds exactly one weapon in each hand, two weapons in all. In his right hand, raised high, is an iron maul: a thick iron haft with a massive block-shaped iron hammer head. In his left hand, held straight out to the side at arm's length, clear of his body, is an iron-banded club: a thick dark wooden club, fat at the end, ringed with three wide grey iron bands.
pose: He stomps forward on two legs facing the viewer and turned a little to the left, weight on the front foot, both heads up, the iron maul raised high in his right hand and the banded club held out wide in his left hand.
must_show: two heads side by side on one body
an iron helmet on each head, the two helmets different
an iron maul in the right hand and an iron-banded club in the left
fur mantle and spiked iron shoulder plate
belt of skulls: clearly the chief, far better armed than the plain ettin
must_not_show: one head hidden behind the other

what: a corrupted light elf: a slender, fair elf, once radiant, now burnt by his own light. He has long pointed ears, a narrow, beautiful, cold face and long straight pale-gold hair hanging loose. His eyes are two blank burning white lights with no pupils. His hands and forearms are charred coal-black up to the elbows and split by bright glowing gold cracks, and the same glowing gold cracks run up his neck and across one cheek. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long slender limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale ivory skin on the face, upper arms and legs; coal-black charred hands and forearms with bright gold cracks; long pale-gold hair; blank white eyes; a white tunic burnt black along its whole hem and sleeve ends; a gold cord belt; one lance of white-gold light.
wears: He wears a plain knee-length sleeveless white tunic with a thin gold border, its whole lower edge burnt ragged and black, a simple gold cord belt and plain leather sandals. His head is bare. No armour, no cloak.
holds: He holds exactly one lance of solid light in both hands, levelled like a pike and pointing to the left: one single perfectly straight bar of bright white-gold light, twice as long as his arm and as thick as his wrist, sharpened to a point at its front end. Both of his charred black hands grip it, one behind the other. There is only this one bar of light in the picture.
pose: He lunges to the left on two legs, seen side-on, front knee bent and back leg stretched out straight behind, driving the lance of light forward and level at chest height in both hands, hair streaming back.
must_show: elf: long pointed ears, slim, fair, pale-gold hair
charred black hands and forearms with gold cracks: burnt by his own light
one straight lance of light held in both hands, pointing left
plain white tunic burnt black at the hem: no armour
realistic adult proportions (small head, long limbs)
must_not_show: sword of light with a hilt
wooden spear with a metal head

what: an elder basilisk, the ancient king of serpents: a very thick, heavy, old snake with no legs and no wings, whose broad flat head wears a tall natural crown of bone: a row of long, thick, smooth white horn points standing upright across the top of its skull, the points of a king's crown, the middle point the tallest. Behind the crown a single row of shorter white bone spikes runs down the back of its neck. Its scales are old and rough, and broad patches of them along its back have turned to cracked pale grey stone. On its brow under the crown is one white blaze mark. It has large round glowing pale yellow eyes with slit pupils and two very long fangs.
colours: very dark blackish-green scales, broad patches of pale stone-grey cracked scales along the back, a pale bone-yellow belly, bone-white crown points and neck spikes, glowing pale yellow eyes, white fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing; its crown is white horn points growing from its skull.
holds: It is a snake with no limbs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, its body lies in three thick heavy coils with the front third reared straight up in an S curve, head turned to the left and lunging down to bite, mouth wide open showing its long fangs, eyes glaring.
must_show: a very thick legless serpent, reared up from its coils
a tall crown of solid white horn points on the head
a row of white spikes down the back of the neck
patches of grey stone scales on a very dark green body
glowing pale yellow eyes and long fangs
older, darker and more crowned than a plain green basilisk
must_not_show: dragon head with a snout and ears
bright smooth emerald body with black bands

what: an elder werewolf: an old, lean, rangy wolf-man standing on two legs, who has been a wolf so long that nothing human is left in him. He has a full wolf's head with a long grizzled muzzle, tall ears, one of them notched, and long bared fangs; a deep chest, long sinewy arms ending in big black claws, wolf's hind legs with paws, and a long bushy tail. Thick shaggy wolf fur covers every part of him: his chest, belly, shoulders, arms and hands are all furred, with no bare skin showing anywhere. His fur has gone pale with age: silver-grey and white all over, darker grey only along the spine. Old scars cross his muzzle and shoulder.
colours: silver-grey and white shaggy fur over the whole body, darker iron-grey along the spine, black claws, yellow-amber eyes, white fangs, dark red cloak rags, dark brown leather.
wears: He wears the last rags of a soldier's dark red cloak, knotted round his neck and hanging in tatters down his back, and a ragged kilt of dark brown leather strips at his hips on a broken belt. No shirt, no trousers, no armour.
holds: Both clawed hands are empty and he holds nothing.
pose: He lunges forward to the left on two legs in a low crouching run, body pitched far forward and head low, one clawed hand slashing out ahead and the other drawn back, jaws wide open to snap, cloak rags streaming behind.
must_show: upright wolf-man on two legs with a wolf's head
pale silver-grey and white fur over the chest, belly and arms
lean, old and scarred
rags of a dark red soldier's cloak at the neck
empty clawed hands
lunging low, jaws snapping

what: an elder manticore, the man-eater of Persian legend: a real lion's body on four legs with a man's face. The body, legs and paws are a lion's, covered in cinnabar-red fur. The head has a lion's great shaggy mane, but the face inside the mane is the face of an old bearded man, with a broad flat nose, pale staring eyes and a very wide open mouth crowded with rows of sharp white teeth. Its mane and beard are streaked grey-white with age, and old scars cross its flank. The lion has no tuft on its tail: its long thick red tail curves up and forward over its back and ends in one big round knob, and the knob bristles all over with dozens of long thick ivory spines pointing outward in every direction.
colours: cinnabar-red and rust-red fur on the body and legs, a dark red-brown mane and beard streaked with grey-white, a weathered tan man's face, ivory tail spines, white teeth, black claws.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it faces left on four legs, front end crouched low and hindquarters high, its tail arched up over its back with the spined knob aimed forward, its man's face roaring with the mouth wide open.
must_show: a lion's body on four legs with red fur
an old bearded man's face inside the mane
a wide mouth with rows of sharp teeth
a tail arched over the back ending in a big cluster of long spines
grey-streaked mane: an old beast
must_not_show: single scorpion sting with no spines

what: an elder mind flayer: a tall, thin, robed figure with the body of a man and the head of an octopus. The head is a large smooth bulbous dome, swept back with deep ridges, with two small blank white eyes; and from the lower half of the head, where a face would be, hang four long thick tentacles that reach down to its waist. Its hands have long thin bony fingers. The skin of the head, the tentacles and the hands alike is dusky purple-grey and wet-looking. It has the proportions of a very tall thin man, about eight heads tall, and holds itself upright and haughty.
colours: dusky purple-grey skin on the head, tentacles and hands; long black robes with rich gold embroidery; a gold chain with one large red gem; blank white eyes; a bright pink-violet light in the palm.
wears: It wears long, heavy, floor-length black robes with wide sleeves, a tall stiff flaring collar that stands up behind its head, a wide mantle embroidered in gold, a gold-buckled sash and a heavy gold chain with one large red gem on its chest.
holds: Both hands are empty. Its right hand is stretched forward with the fingers spread, and a ball of bright pink-violet light the size of an apple sits in the open palm, touching the hand. Its left hand is raised with two fingertips pressed to the side of its own head. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: It strides forward to the left, leaning into the step with its robes swinging, right arm thrust out with the light in its palm, left hand at its temple, its four long tentacles lifting and curling forward.
must_show: an octopus head: smooth ridged dome, face tentacles hanging to the waist
purple-grey skin on head and hands
grand black and gold robes with a tall flaring collar

what: an elder vampire: a very old, very tall, gaunt vampire nobleman who has been dead for a thousand years. His skin is corpse-pale grey-white, dead flesh, never living pink, drawn tight over sharp cheekbones on his face and on his hands alike. He has a high bald forehead, with long thin white hair hanging from the back and sides of his head to his shoulders, long pointed ears, deep-sunk glowing red eyes, an open mouth showing two long white fangs, and long thin fingers ending in long black claws. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, narrow shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: corpse-pale grey-white skin, long white hair, red eyes, a dark red brocade coat with tarnished gold embroidery, a black cape with a dark red lining, a tarnished gold chain, black boots, black claws.
wears: He wears the court dress of a vanished age: a long dark red brocade coat with tarnished gold embroidery, buttoned to the throat, a heavy tarnished gold chain of office across his chest, tall black boots, and a long black cape with a dark red lining and a tall stiff collar standing up behind his head, its hem worn to tatters. His head is bare.
holds: Both clawed hands are empty and he holds nothing.
pose: He lunges forward to the left on two legs, weight on the bent front leg, one clawed hand reaching far out ahead to seize and the other raised and drawn back, cape flaring out behind him, fangs bared.
must_show: a gaunt, ancient vampire with corpse-pale grey-white skin
high bald forehead with long white hair behind
fangs, red eyes and pointed ears
antique dark red and gold court coat with a chain of office
black cape with a tall collar
empty clawed hands, lunging

what: an elder beholder: an ancient floating eyeball monster. Its whole body is one round sphere of cracked, scarred, stony hide, a ball hanging in the air, with a perfectly round outline at the sides and underneath. In the middle of the front of the sphere is exactly one enormous round eyeball with a blood-red iris and a slit pupil, as wide as half the sphere, the single eye of a cyclops, under a heavy brow ridge that carries a row of short thick pale grey horns; there is no nose and no second eye on the sphere. Directly under the big eye is a very wide mouth of long sharp ivory fangs. The only things that stick out of the sphere are on its top: a great thick crown of very many long, thick, curving stalks crowded together in two rows, each stalk ending in one small yellow eye.
colours: charcoal-black and ash-grey cracked hide, pale grey brow horns, one huge blood-red central eye, small yellow stalk eyes, ivory fangs.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It is only a sphere and holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in the air, tilted forward and turned slightly to the left, the one big red eye wide open and glaring, fanged mouth open, its many long stalks fanned out above it in a great crown, every stalk eye turned forward.
must_show: a round sphere body with a clean round outline underneath and at the sides
exactly one huge central eye, red
a wide mouth of long fangs under the eye
a dense crown of very many long eyestalks on top
black and ash-grey cracked hide with a horned brow: older and grimmer than a maroon, golden-eyed beholder

what: an elder storm giant: an ancient giant king of the storm, a towering, powerfully built old man. His skin is pale blue-grey, the colour of a rain cloud, on his face, arms, hands and legs alike. He has a very long white beard reaching to his belt, long white hair blown sideways, and a stern lined face with glowing white eyes. Thin bright forks of yellow-white lightning crawl over the skin of his bare arms. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale blue-grey skin, white beard and hair, white eyes, a bronze breastplate with gold cloud-scrolls, a gold circlet, a dark blue tunic, a storm-grey cloak, a grey iron hammer head on a dark wooden haft bound in bronze, yellow-white lightning.
wears: He wears a bronze breastplate worked with gold cloud-scrolls over a knee-length dark blue tunic, bronze bracers and greaves, a plain gold circlet on his brow and a long storm-grey cloak blowing from his shoulders. His arms are bare.
holds: He grips exactly one great war hammer in both hands, both hands on its haft: a thick long dark wooden haft bound in bronze, with a massive block-shaped grey iron head, and yellow-white lightning crackling close round the hammer head.
pose: He stands on two legs with his feet wide apart and his body twisted at the waist, the hammer swung up over his right shoulder in both hands ready to strike down to the left, beard and cloak blowing sideways.
must_show: an old giant with pale blue-grey skin and a white beard to the belt
one great war hammer held in both hands
lightning on the hammer head and on his arms
bronze breastplate and a gold circlet: a king among giants
realistic adult proportions (small head, long limbs)
must_not_show: lightning bolt held as a spear

what: an elder dracolich: the skeleton of an immense ancient dragon, long dead, a four-legged beast seen from the side with all four feet down and its backbone level. It is bare bone and nothing else. Its skull is a dragon's: long, narrow and wedge-shaped, with a long snout and long jaws full of big teeth, and a crown of many long backswept horns ringing the back of it. Behind the skull come a long neck of thick vertebrae stretched forward and low, a great ribcage of tall curved ribs with wide empty gaps between them, four thick leg bones ending in claw bones, and a long tail of vertebrae held out behind and ending in a heavy club of bone. Tall bone spikes run down the spine. From its shoulders rise two wing skeletons: each is a fan of five long thin finger bones with empty backdrop showing between them, and only a few short black rags hanging from the bones. Every bone, the skull included, is dark: charcoal-grey bone, clearly lit, with paler ash-grey highlights along each bone. A bright pale green witchlight burns in each eye socket, and a bigger ball of the same bright pale green witchlight burns inside the ribcage, shining out between the ribs.
colours: charcoal-grey bone with ash-grey highlights on every part, the skull included; a few short black rags on the wing bones; bright pale green witchlight in the eye sockets and inside the ribcage. The bones stay dark grey.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it stalks to the left on all four legs with its backbone level, neck stretched forward and low, jaws wide open, both wing skeletons raised and fanned above its back, the clubbed tail held out straight behind.
must_show: a dragon's skeleton on four legs, backbone level: bare bone, open ribs
a long-snouted dragon skull with a crown of many long horns
every bone dark grey, the skull included, but clearly lit
bare wing bones with gaps between them, only rags of membrane
bright pale green witchlight in the eye sockets and ribcage
a tail ending in a bone club
must_not_show: rearing up on its hind legs
